tools.name: search_accommodations
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a homestay or short stay in South Korea. Filters by area or theme, dates, adult guests, and nightly price in KRW, and returns matching Wehome listings with price, rating, and a link to the listing. Only covers South Korea. Does not make a reservation.

tools.name: get_smart_suggestions
tools.description: Use this when the user gives a partial or unclear place name and needs matching area or listing names on Wehome before searching. Returns text suggestions only.
